title: Orientation
description: horizontal: a strip, avatar beside name, rank and pp. vertical: a stacked card. auto picks whichever fits the page size larger (a wide page gets the strip). The tag scales to the page.

title: Alignment
description: Side of the page the tag hugs. right puts the avatar on the outer right edge (for the right side of the screen); left mirrors it.

title: Backing
description: none: text floats on the game with a light shadow. scrim: a soft dark fade behind the tag. panel: a graphite plate.

title: Accent colour
description: map: the rank mark and avatar corners take a colour from the current beatmap's background (amber when it has none). 18-lab: always amber.

title: Show avatar
description: Your profile picture from a.ppy.sh (or the custom avatar below); your initial stands in when it cannot load. Off hides the avatar and makes no outside request.

title: Show session changes
description: Beside rank and pp: the change since this source loaded (green gains, red losses), kept per account and ruleset. Live values only. Reload the source to start a new session.

title: Custom username
description: Shown instead of the live username when not empty. Any custom value makes the tag show during gameplay even without a signed-in profile (the replay renderer keeps the profile idle).

title: Custom avatar
description: Image URL or data: URI (e.g. data:image/png;base64,…) shown instead of your a.ppy.sh picture when not empty. The replay renderer blocks every outside URL, a.ppy.sh included: use a data: URI there, or leave it empty for the initial.

title: Custom global rank
description: Shown instead of the live rank when not empty. A number (#4,120 or 4120) is formatted; other text is shown as typed.

title: Custom pp
description: Shown instead of the live pp when not empty. A number is formatted; other text is shown as typed.

title: Custom country
description: Country code (e.g. US) shown instead of the live one when not empty.
